text: 孙悟空赴蟠桃会——不请自到
pinyin: sūn wù kōng fù pán táo huì —— bù qǐng zì dào
literal: Sun Wukong · attend · Peach Banquet — not · invite · self · arrive
natural: Monkey King attending the Peach Banquet uninvited

meaning.zh: 孙悟空没被邀请就去参加蟠桃会，比喻不请自来。

examples.zh: 聚会他孙悟空赴蟠桃会，不请自到。
examples.en: He gatecrashed the party.

examples.zh: 孙悟空赴蟠桃会——不请自到，大家都很尴尬。
examples.en: He came uninvited, and everyone felt awkward.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. From 《西游记》, where the Monkey King sneaks into the Queen Mother's Peach Banquet.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。出自《西游记》，孙悟空闯入王母娘娘的蟠桃会。

pinyin: táng sēng qǔ jīng —— qiān xīn wàn kǔ
literal: Tang monk · fetch · scriptures — thousand · hardships · ten thousand · bitterness
natural: Tang Monk fetching the scriptures: a thousand hardships

meaning.en: Going through enormous hardship to reach a goal.
meaning.zh: 唐僧西天取经历经艰难，比喻历尽千辛万苦。

equivalents: go through hell and high water

examples.zh: 为了拿到这个项目，我们唐僧取经，千辛万苦。
examples.en: We went through enormous hardship to win this project.

examples.zh: 唐僧取经——千辛万苦，终于成功了。
examples.en: After endless hardships, we finally made it.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. From 《西游记》, in which the monk Xuanzang journeys west for Buddhist scriptures.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。出自《西游记》，唐僧西天取经。

text: 孙悟空保唐僧——忠心耿耿
pinyin: sūn wù kōng bǎo táng sēng —— zhōng xīn gěng gěng
literal: Sun Wukong · protect · Tang monk — loyal · heart · devoted · devoted
natural: Monkey King protecting Tang Monk: utterly loyal

meaning.zh: 孙悟空一路保护唐僧，比喻对人忠诚不二。

examples.zh: 他对老板孙悟空保唐僧，忠心耿耿。
examples.en: He's utterly loyal to the boss.

examples.zh: 孙悟空保唐僧——忠心耿耿，这样的下属难得。
examples.en: Such a loyal subordinate is rare.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

pinyin: jiǎ bǎo yù chū jiā —— kàn pò hóng chén
literal: Jia Baoyu · leave · home · (as monk) — see · through · red · dust
natural: Jia Baoyu becoming a monk: seeing through the mortal world

meaning.zh: 贾宝玉最终出家，比喻看透世事、不再留恋。

equivalents: see through the vanities of life

examples.zh: 他辞职隐居，像贾宝玉出家，看破红尘。
examples.en: He quit and withdrew from the world, disillusioned.

examples.zh: 贾宝玉出家——看破红尘了。
examples.en: He has seen through the world's vanities.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. From 《红楼梦》, where Jia Baoyu becomes a monk at the end.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。出自《红楼梦》，贾宝玉最终出家。

text: 捉了虱子跑了牛——得不偿失
pinyin: zhuō le shī zi pǎo le niú —— dé bù cháng shī
literal: catch · (particle) · louse · run away · (particle) · ox — gain · not · repay · loss
natural: Catching a louse and losing the ox

meaning.en: The gain is not worth the loss.
meaning.zh: 为捉虱子而让牛跑了，比喻因小失大。

equivalents: lose the battle to win a skirmish

examples.zh: 为省几块钱耽误了大事，捉了虱子跑了牛。
examples.en: Saving a few yuan while ruining the big deal is penny wise, pound foolish.

examples.zh: 捉了虱子跑了牛，这笔买卖不划算。
examples.en: This deal isn't worth it.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

pinyin: shǔ ní qiū de —— yuán huá

meaning.zh: 泥鳅身子滑，比喻人处世圆滑、不肯担责。

examples.zh: 他是属泥鳅的，谁也抓不住他的把柄。
examples.en: He's slippery as an eel; no one can pin him down.

examples.zh: 属泥鳅的——圆滑得很，问他什么都不正面回答。
examples.en: He's slick and never answers directly.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

pinyin: zhú zi zhǎng chà —— jié wài shēng zhī
literal: bamboo · grow · branch — joint · outside · sprout · branch
natural: Bamboo sprouting a branch away from a joint

meaning.zh: 竹子在节外长枝，比喻在原有问题之外又生出新问题。

examples.zh: 本来谈好了，他又提条件，竹子长杈，节外生枝。
examples.en: It was all agreed, then he added conditions; new complications.

examples.zh: 竹子长杈——节外生枝，事情变复杂了。
examples.en: New problems cropped up and complicated things.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

pinyin: zhú shāi zi dōu shuǐ —— lòu dòng bǎi chū
literal: bamboo · sieve · scoop · water — hole · hundred · emerge
natural: Scooping water with a bamboo sieve: full of holes

meaning.zh: 竹筛子装不住水，比喻说话做事破绽极多。

examples.zh: 他的说法竹筛子兜水，漏洞百出。
examples.en: His account is full of holes.

examples.zh: 这份计划竹筛子兜水，根本经不起检查。
examples.en: This plan is riddled with flaws and won't survive scrutiny.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

pinyin: zhū zōng shuān dòu fǔ —— méi fǎ tí
literal: pig · bristle · tie · tofu — no · way · lift (mention)
natural: Tying tofu with a pig bristle: can't be lifted

meaning.en: Not worth mentioning, or not to be mentioned.
meaning.zh: 猪鬃拴豆腐提不起来，谐“提”为“提起”，比喻不值一提或不堪提起。

examples.zh: 他的成绩猪鬃拴豆腐，没法提。
examples.en: His grades are not worth mentioning.

examples.zh: 那件事猪鬃拴豆腐，别再提了。
examples.en: That affair isn't to be raised again.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. A play on 提: 'lift' and 'mention'.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。双关：“提”既指提起，也指提及。

pinyin: zhū xuè zhǔ dòu fǔ —— hēi bái fēn míng
literal: pig · blood · cook · tofu — black · white · distinct · clear
natural: Pig's blood cooked with tofu: black and white clearly apart

meaning.en: Clear-cut; right and wrong plainly distinguished.
meaning.zh: 猪血黑、豆腐白，比喻是非分明。

examples.zh: 在原则问题上，他猪血煮豆腐，黑白分明。
examples.en: On matters of principle, he sees things in black and white.

examples.zh: 这事猪血煮豆腐——黑白分明，错在谁一目了然。
examples.en: It's clear-cut who was in the wrong.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 猪向前拱，鸡住后刨——各有各的门道
pinyin: zhū xiàng qián gǒng, jī zhù hòu páo —— gè yǒu gè de mén dào
literal: pig · forward · root, chicken · backward · scratch — each · have · each · 's · way
natural: Pigs root forwards, chickens scratch backwards: each has its own way

meaning.en: Everyone has their own way of getting things done.
meaning.zh: 猪往前拱、鸡往后刨，各有各的办法，比喻各人有各人的路数。

examples.zh: 猪向前拱，鸡住后刨，他们各有各的门道。
examples.en: Each of them has their own way of doing things.

examples.zh: 猪向前拱，鸡住后刨，别管人家怎么做。
examples.en: Never mind how others do it; each has their own method.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 猪头挂在花椒树上——肉麻
pinyin: zhū tóu guà zài huā jiāo shù shàng —— ròu má
literal: pig · head · hang · on · Sichuan pepper · tree · on — flesh · numb
natural: A pig's head hung on a pepper tree: the flesh goes numb

meaning.zh: 花椒让肉发麻，谐“肉麻”，形容言行过分亲昵、做作，令人起鸡皮疙瘩。

examples.zh: 他当众说那些情话，真是猪头挂在花椒树上。
examples.en: Saying those sweet nothings in public is cringeworthy.

examples.zh: 猪头挂在花椒树上——肉麻死了。
examples.en: How cringeworthy.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. A pun: 麻 means 'numb' (from the pepper's numbing effect), and 肉麻 means 'cringeworthy'.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。双关：花椒使肉发麻，“肉麻”即令人起鸡皮疙瘩。

text: 猪八戒喝磨刀水——内秀（锈）
pinyin: zhū bā jiè hē mó dāo shuǐ —— nèi xiù (xiù)
literal: Pigsy · drink · knife-sharpening · water — inside · rust (elegant)
natural: Pigsy drinking whetstone water: rust inside

meaning.en: Plain on the outside but gifted within.
meaning.zh: 磨刀水里有铁锈，谐“内秀”，比喻外表不起眼而内在聪明有才。

equivalents: don't judge a book by its cover

examples.zh: 别看他不爱说话，猪八戒喝磨刀水，内秀着呢。
examples.en: Don't be fooled by his quietness; he's got hidden talent.

examples.zh: 猪八戒喝磨刀水——内秀，她其实很聪明。
examples.en: She is quietly brilliant.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. A pun: 锈 (xiù, rust) sounds like 秀 (xiù, talented), so 内锈 hints at 内秀, 'gifted within'.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。谐音双关：“锈”与“秀”同音，“内锈”暗指“内秀”。

pinyin: zhū bā jiè gǒng lián zi —— zuǐ xiān jìn
literal: Pigsy · push · curtain — mouth · first · enter
natural: Pigsy pushing through a curtain: snout first

meaning.en: Putting the mouth first; eager to eat or talk.
meaning.zh: 猪八戒用嘴拱帘子，嘴先进去，比喻人嘴馋或爱抢着说话。

examples.zh: 一听有好吃的，他猪八戒拱帘子，嘴先进。
examples.en: The moment he heard there was food, his mouth led the way.

examples.zh: 猪八戒拱帘子——嘴先进，他总是话在人前。
examples.en: He always speaks before anyone else.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 诸葛亮焚香操琴——故弄玄虚
pinyin: zhū gě liàng fén xiāng cāo qín —— gù nòng xuán xū
literal: Zhuge Liang · burn · incense · play · zither — deliberately · play · mystery · void
natural: Zhuge Liang burning incense and playing the zither

meaning.zh: 诸葛亮空城计中焚香弹琴，比喻故意装神秘、迷惑对方。

equivalents: put on an act to bluff

examples.zh: 他不说结果，诸葛亮焚香操琴，故弄玄虚。
examples.en: He won't say the result; he's being deliberately mysterious.

examples.zh: 别诸葛亮焚香操琴了，说实话吧。
examples.en: Stop the mystery act and tell the truth.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. It refers to the 'Empty Fort Strategy' in 《三国演义》.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。典出《三国演义》“空城计”。

pinyin: zhōng kuí jià mèi —— guǐ hùn (hūn)
literal: Zhong Kui · marry off · sister — ghost · mix (marry)
natural: Zhong Kui marrying off his sister: a crowd of ghosts

meaning.en: A pun: 'mixing with ghosts' but also 'hanging about aimlessly'.
meaning.zh: 钟馗嫁妹时周围都是鬼，谐“鬼混”，比喻不务正业、胡乱混日子。

examples.zh: 他整天钟馗嫁妹，鬼混度日。
examples.en: He fools around all day with nothing to show.

examples.zh: 钟馗嫁妹——鬼混，你别跟他们一起。
examples.en: Don't hang around with that lot.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. A pun: 婚 (hūn, wedding) sounds like 混 (hùn, muddle along); 鬼混 means 'to fool around'.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。谐音双关：“婚”与“混”音近，“鬼混”即胡混度日。
